# Structured interview — meeting archetype

## When this lens applies

Apply this lens when one person works through prepared questions with another,
including research, discovery, or assessment interviews.

## What to extract

- Map questions to answered, partial, or unanswered responses.
- Capture response summaries, short supporting excerpts, deviations from the
  script, and the most important findings.

## Missing topics worth noting

Name skipped or partially answered questions that affect the interview's goal.

## Common interpretation mistakes

Do not mistake interviewer framing for the participant's view or discard useful
off-script discoveries because they were not on the questionnaire.
